mapper.insert: INSERT INTO email_otp (email, purpose, code_hash, user_id, attempt_count, expires_at) VALUES (#{email}, #{purpose}, #{codeHash}, #{userId}, #{attemptCount}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM email_otp WHERE email = #{email} AND purpose = #{purpose} AND consumed_at IS NULL AND expires_at > now() ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE email_otp SET attempt_count = attempt_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE email_otp SET consumed_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE email_otp SET consumed_at = now() WHERE email = #{email} AND purpose = #{purpose} AND consumed_at IS NULL
